citations.quote: Planned treatment is the planned arm of the subject (DM.ARM).

statement: Planned treatment is the planned arm of the subject (DM.ARM).

citations.quote: Actual treatment will be taken to be the same as planned treatment.

statement: Actual treatment is the same as planned treatment.

citations.quote: The treatment start date will be the earliest start date among any exposure records.

statement: The treatment start date is the earliest start date of any exposure record.

citations.quote: The treatment end date is the latest end date of an exposure record with a dose.

statement: The treatment end date is the latest end date of an exposure record with a dose.

citations.quote: A partial exposure date is not completed and is left out of the treatment dates.

statement: A partial exposure date is not completed and is left out of the treatment dates.

citations.quote: Study day 1 is the treatment start date.

statement: Study day 1 is the treatment start date.

citations.quote: The randomized set will hold every randomized subject with at least one post-baseline value of the vital sign SYSBP.

statement: The randomized set holds every randomized subject with at least one post-baseline value of the vital sign SYSBP.

citations.quote: The safety set holds every subject who received at least one dose of study treatment.

statement: The safety set holds every subject who received at least one dose of study treatment.

citations.quote: Safety analyses group subjects by actual treatment.

statement: Safety analyses group subjects by actual treatment.
The efficacy-evaluable set holds every subject of the safety set with a baseline value and at least one post-baseline value of the vital sign WEIGHT.

citations.quote: The end-of-study record is the disposition event record of the subject.

statement: The end-of-study record is the disposition event record of the subject.

citations.quote: When a partial adverse event start date has a known month, it is completed with the first day of that month.

statement: A partial adverse event start date with a known month is completed with the first day of that month.

citations.quote: An adverse event is treatment-emergent when it starts on or after the treatment start date.

statement: An adverse event is treatment-emergent when it starts on or after the treatment start date.

citations.quote: Treatment emergence has no end date.

statement: Treatment emergence has no end date.
An adverse event is related to study treatment when its causality is one of "PROBABLY RELATED", "RELATED".

citations.quote: The planned outputs include the adverse event summary table.

statement: The planned outputs include the adverse event summary table.

citations.quote: The efficacy-evaluable set is the analysis set for the adverse event summary table.

statement: The analysis set of the adverse event summary table is the efficacy-evaluable set.

citations.quote: The treatment columns of the adverse event summary table are in ascending order of dose, with placebo first.

statement: The treatment columns of the adverse event summary table are in ascending order of dose, with placebo first.

citations.quote: The adverse event summary table will include a total column that pools the treatment arms other than Placebo.

statement: A total column of the adverse event summary table pools the treatment arms other than Placebo.

citations.quote: Percentages in the adverse event summary table have one decimal, and a count of zero is shown without a percentage.

statement: Percentages in the adverse event summary table have one decimal, and a count of zero is shown without a percentage.

citations.quote: Displayed numbers in the adverse event summary table are rounded half away from zero.

statement: Displayed numbers in the adverse event summary table are rounded half away from zero.

citations.quote: The adverse event summary table will show the rows FATAL, SERIOUS, RELATED, ANY, in this order.

statement: The rows of the adverse event summary table are, in this order, FATAL, SERIOUS, RELATED, ANY.
